notes:
REF-BM-03: Description is editable during creation and duplicate handling, but hidden in the normal post-save editor.
REF-BM-04: The editor supports title, tags, and note, but not URL, and normally hides description editing.
REF-BM-11: Tag chips are not selectable and there is no dedicated tag-filter control.
REF-BM-14: Search implements tag:NAME rather than the required #tag syntax.
REF-BM-20: There is no multi-selection or bulk-action interface.
REF-BM-21: There is no whole-filtered-collection bulk action.
REF-BM-22: There is no selectable list sorting.
REF-BM-23: Notes can be written and edited but are neither Markdown-rendered nor displayed in a bookmark view.
REF-BM-24: A structured readable copy is stored, not a single-file HTML snapshot, and PDFs are unsupported.
REF-BM-25: Internet Archive snapshot creation is not implemented.
REF-BM-26: Bookmarks cannot be archived or hidden from the default list/search.
REF-BM-27: Reversible bookmark archiving is absent; only permanent deletion and page-copy capture exist.
REF-BM-28: There is no archived-bookmarks list.
REF-BM-29: Saved search/tag bundles are not implemented.
REF-BM-30: Netscape HTML import is not implemented.
REF-BM-31: Netscape HTML export is not implemented.
REF-BM-32: Display-related personal settings are not implemented.
